name: Jindai Komaki
source:
Komaki is a second-year at Eisui Girls' High School in Kagoshima Prefecture. She and the other members of Eisui's team are shrine maidens; she belongs to the primary branch family of the maidens' lineage and is affectionately called "Princess" by the others. A year prior to the events of the story she had achieved fame as one of the new monsters of the nationals, but pushed herself too hard. Komaki is a kind girl who respects her opponents and tries to give her all in return. She is also loved and respected by all of her teammates.

While awake, Komaki is just a normal girl who tries to do her best but isn't very good. Her true power is shown when she sleeps during matches. At this point she is possessed by one of the 8 goddess spirits that inhabit her. What ability she gains is dependent on which spirit possesses her. She cannot control which one descends; the stronger her opponents, the stronger the spirit.
